# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 13 Jul 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Launches & Upcoming Sales

- **Dunearn House opens for sales bookings on 25 July — first private condo in Bukit Timah Turf City** - A consortium of Frasers Property, CSC Land Group, and Sekisui House is launching Dunearn House with a public preview from 10 July and sales bookings on 25 July 2026, with prices starting from S$1.475M. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/dunearn-house-set-to-launch-from-s1-475m-first-condo-in-turf-city/)

- **Dunearn House unit mix and pricing reviewed — indicative prices from S$2,799 psf** - A detailed walkthrough of Dunearn House covers its layouts, site plan, and unit mix, noting a S$1.1M price gap between entry-level units and 3-bedroom units. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/dunearn-house-condo-review/)

- **H1 2026 new condo launches in review — River Modern sells 93% over debut weekend** - The private residential and EC markets held momentum through the first half of 2026, with River Modern selling 93% of its 455 units at a median price of S$3,229 psf on its launch weekend. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/new-condo-launches-2026/)

## HDB Supply & Future Housing Sites

- **Gillman Barracks to be redeveloped into a new housing estate — 25 buildings and 8 hectares of forest retained** - HDB studies confirm the 40-hectare Gillman Barracks site will be redeveloped for both public and private housing, with 25 of 86 existing buildings and 8 hectares of forest preserved. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/gillman-barracks-set-to-become-a-new-housing-estate/)

- **Two-thirds of Maju Forest to be cleared for future HDB housing — 8 hectares preserved** - HDB will clear 15 hectares of Maju Forest for public housing while retaining 8 hectares, including a nature trail and freshwater stream connecting to Bukit Timah and Central Catchment nature reserves. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/two-thirds-of-maju-forest-will-be-cleared-for-future-hdb-housing/)

## HDB Resale Records & Infrastructure

- **Tampines executive flat transacts at S$1.24M — new record for the town** - A 31-year-old Tampines executive HDB flat has changed hands for S$1.24 million, setting a new resale price record for the town. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/31-year-old-tampines-executive-hdb-flat-sets-towns-new-high-at-s1-24-million/)

- **Circle Line Stage 6 opens 12 July 2026, completing the loop between HarbourFront and Marina Bay** - CCL6 entered passenger service on 12 July 2026, with rental properties near the new stations noted as newly accessible following the loop's completion. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/why-renting-near-the-new-circle-line-stations-makes-sense-in-2026/)
